Architect project description identifies a three-storey atrium with floor-to-ceiling glazing and separate townhouse blocks behind the main building.
Original procedural brick and stucco tiles are generated for this asset; third-party photos are not shipped as textures.

Atrium width, window positions and dimensions, door dimensions, canopy size, sign lettering size, and all unseen wall/roof details are approximate.

Repeated framed windows on five additional long boundary edges are estimated side treatments inspired by the second directly viewed wing photo; edge assignment, bay spacing and dimensions are not compass-verified.
